name: Burning Hands
description: Level 1 Evocation (Tidecaller, Shipwright) Casting Time: Action Range: Self Components: V, S Duration: Instantaneous A thin sheet of flames shoots forth from you. Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a Agility saving throw, taking 3d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects in the Cone that aren't being worn or carried start burning. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.
